steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Severin, I need everything you have on the Catastrophe Messenger named Biederman.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Biederman? Why?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: An old man told me he saw Biederman leading the riot. He's the one who destroyed the power plant.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: An old man? Is he a reliable source?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: He called himself 'the last of the Winterwisps.'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: He... He's still alive? No. He might be a fraud.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: A man like that wouldn't lie. It's just my intuition, but I don't think he would ever lie.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: This is his diary and his knife. I took them as keepsakes.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But that means he must be...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I never expected this. I thought all his kind threw themselves into the lake.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'll go see him. I... I don't know. Should I go see him?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: He told me the whole story. According to him, the Winterwisps weren't behind this.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: And he had no hate for you. He spoke very calmly.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I understand why, but the rioters do use the Winterwisp as an excuse for their looting.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: And it's just that. An excuse.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Even if it's an excuse, they committed crimes. Next, they'll demand we throw open the granary and leave us to starve.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Besides, the Winterwisps have all mixed with the Wolumonders. At this point... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No matter the excuse, we can't trust them with our lives.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We have a Catastrophe Messenger who should have died. Not only did he live, but he sparked a rebellion, and nobody even knew about it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Putting it all together, it does seem likely that he was behind it.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Yes, it makes sense. If Biederman is indeed still alive, he is the one who could foment an uprising. And he knows Wolumonde is on the brink of famine.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What about a motive?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...The Great Rift.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: After the Catastrophe, people blamed him for the damage to the town.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: In a matter of months, we stopped at least seven acts of violence against him. There were more we weren't even aware of.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: After that, he shut himself inside and refused to come out. Most days, he drank himself to violent outbursts. That is until Dr. Atro broke down the door of his house.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sh-she broke it down?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Dr. Atro reached out to Biederman after he hit rock bottom. From then on, he was usually there helping her with her work.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It sounds like they got along?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Sure, at least on the surface. That's why I never suspected him. Biederman was always melancholic. And even when he worked with Dr. Atro, we never saw him smile.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The more understanding townsfolk like myself tolerated him and his work. But he had enough of an excuse to seek vengeance on us.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Emotionally, he has a clear motivation. Not that that means anything.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Pretty much everyone has some reason or another to try to get back at someone.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Vengeance... it's always vengeance.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And before you get too comfortable with this, you did tell us Biederman was dead.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You didn't positively identify the bodies. So you missed this possibility.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But you can't just assume—*cough* *cough*—*hack* *hack*

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: —Just, a moment.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Why did it get all quiet out there?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The townsfolk are on the move! They... they've gone to siege Zwölftontechnik Strasse!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What?! Get out there and stop them!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We don't know who might be hiding in Zwölftontechnik Strasse. What if your 'Reunion' is holed up in there?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I- I tried. But they were too agitated. They wouldn't listen to reason!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They learned about 'Reunion' from somewhere!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Grr... those excitable yokels!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: There is a lot of movement in the town.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: And also... It looks like someone found their way here.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: They raised a militia and started combing a town... That means they've already decided to go to war.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The townsfolk know we're here. They want to burn us alive.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Burn?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Originium Arts are part of their normal schooling. Even their teamsters can do simple Arts. Starting a fire is easy enough for them.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We can't stay here. Will Rhodes Island lead the charge?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I think... it's just the angry people. They see us as villains, drenched in sin. They are the ones who want to drive us away.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't forget our people died in this town.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We respect your choice, but you're still young... and you don't yet understand the meaning behind this.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Just so you know, we're not all that easily roused.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If we fight, an entire city will come after us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If we run, they'll brand us as arsonists, partisans, bandits. What's the difference?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The normal Sarkaz way is pretty simple: just destroy the town. Level it. Done.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The only tricky part was the automatic Arts units. But their infighting already dealt with those.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Just give the order, and we'll leave the moon to rest forever in the Winterwisp Mountains. Spring... will never come.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Winter... is long, this year.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Time to make up your mind, Mudrock.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Give us back our home! Out with the bandits! Out with the Infected!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Weapons here! Men, come arm yourselves. Everyone with decent Arts!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What's happening? Why does it feel like they're preparing for war?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That's about right. It is a war.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Woah! GreyThroat! Gimme a little warning next time!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: At least, that's what it is to them. They think they're fighting a war.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: But why? Are the other operators okay?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I wouldn't say okay. It seems like Severin didn't want this to happen. Things are getting out of hand.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Folinic says she found some clues. The man in this picture, one Biederman, is now one of our key suspects.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Ayerscarpe is operating on his own. Remember this man. We just need to know where he is. He's probably the one behind this insurgency.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Find the bad guy! Got it!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What about Reunion?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: They set themselves up in a small, abandoned hunting village. People go in and out every day, but the big one doesn't move.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Oh, and while I was figuring out which way to go, I found a small group that seemed to be patrolling around the edge of the town.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It couldn't be...?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Wh-what's that?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: A rock? A giant made out of stone? G-get some Arts on it! But not fire! Fire's useless!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Does anyone know any other Originium Arts?! Hurry. We have to stop it!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: It's no use!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: You're making fools of yourselves. They aren't alive. They're just a bunch of rocks cobbled together by some Arts.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: We need an artificer to get the 'Gramophone' back! Use it on that thing!

steps.name: Rebellious Infected
steps.text: You think you can get away with this?!

steps.name: Rebellious Infected
steps.text: Give it up! Open your eyes! You know why this is happening. You know what brought ruin to Wolumonde!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: It's all you! Damned Winterwisps! Teaming up with Infected to steal the town!

steps.name: Rebellious Infected
steps.text: What a bunch of morons! Heads full of music and garbage art! Don't you see this is the end of Wolumonde?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I know. But it would've ended quicker if we just handed it over to you.

steps.name: Rebellious Infected
steps.text: Has Severin ever told you how much food you have stored? Did he say when the town will get back on course? No! Never! There's no hope!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: That's your fault! You destroyed my home!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Wrong! It's you high and mighty nobles who pushed us to desperation!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: And that's why you're killing people?!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic! We have to stop them!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Now that we know who could be behind this, we shouldn't be hurting each other like this.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Let's go talk to them. We can convince them not to storm the town hall. They know Rhodes Island, so there should be a way.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Why... why are you stopping me?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If we don't do something...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Silently shakes her head)

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic?
There is no room for argument or invective on the battlefield. Life passes quickly. Time is short.
Truly.
Neither side knows what to debate.
It is unclear why they went to war, why they give their lives in vain.
Indeed. Rather few hold on to any ideals after taking up arms.
But now, before my very eyes, they fight one another, not only with weapons, but also with words. They cast blame along with stones.
A rare sight.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I can tell. You're still reluctant.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Reluctant...? When we came here, we only planned to... No. There's no point. There hasn't been, since we first set foot in Wolumonde.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We lost four of our people in the fire. I've already stopped so many. But now, the other Infected must be given... perspective.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Otherwise, we will lose control. No. The rage, the longing, will go unsated. We may even turn back to the way we were...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If you hate Reunion so much, why did you join in the first place?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Never mind.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's time to fight.
